title: Synergistic theoretical and electrochemical evaluation of sulfonamide-based inhibitors for mild steel corrosion in HCl
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,30872-30888
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA02832B, Paper

Soukaina Alaoui Mrani, Dounia Azzouni, Chahrazad El Abiad, Smail Radi, Fakhreldeen Dabiellil, Mohamed Hussien, Yousef A. Bin Jardan, Muhammad Shahab, Mustapha Taleb
Sulfonamide compounds SAP4–SAP6 were evaluated as mild steel corrosion inhibitors in 1 M HCl. Results showed strong adsorption and high inhibition, with SAP5 giving the best efficiency (95%) via a stable protective film.
